# Devices

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_device_catalog.py from pihole_control/constants.py. Do not edit by hand: run the tool. -->

The plugin creates the devices below. The unit numbers are the ones of the plugin before 0.1.0 and never change, so an upgrade keeps every device, its history, scenes, scripts and schedules.

## Statistics (units 1-10)

Created when missing (at start and at every poll), read-only, in use from the start; counters show their unit. Values come from the reply of `GET /api/stats/summary`.

| Unit | Name | Type | Unit label | Source |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | DNS Queries Today | Custom Sensor | queries | `queries.total` |
| 2 | Ads Blocked Today | Custom Sensor | blocked | `queries.blocked` |
| 3 | Ads Percentage | Percentage | - | `queries.percent_blocked` |
| 4 | Domains in Blocklist | Custom Sensor | domains | `gravity.domains_being_blocked` |
| 5 | Queries Forwarded | Custom Sensor | queries | `queries.forwarded` |
| 6 | Queries Cached | Custom Sensor | queries | `queries.cached` |
| 7 | Clients Ever Seen | Custom Sensor | clients | `clients.total` |
| 8 | Unique Clients | Custom Sensor | clients | `clients.active` |
| 9 | Unique Domains | Custom Sensor | domains | `queries.unique_domains` |
| 10 | Pi-hole Status | Switch (On/Off), read-only | - | the connection: On while polls succeed, Off while they fail |

Unchanged values are rewritten every 300 seconds so Domoticz' sensor time-out never marks a quiet sensor as dead. A value the Pi-hole does not report leaves its device untouched.

## Block lists (units 100-199)

One On/Off switch per list of the Pi-hole (block and allow lists). On = the list is enabled.

| | |
|---|---|
| Name | `List: <comment> (<groups>)`, e.g. `List: Kids - Social Media (Kids)`. Without a comment the list address is used, without groups the part in brackets is left out |
| Description | `ListID:<id>` (the Pi-hole's id of the list; this is how a device finds its list again) |
| Units | the next free one from 100 to 199, so at most 100 lists |

## Groups (units 200-255)

One On/Off switch per group of the Pi-hole. On = the group is enabled.

| | |
|---|---|
| Name | `Group: <name>`, e.g. `Group: Kids` |
| Description | `GroupID:<id>` |
| Units | the next free one from 200 to 255, so at most 56 groups |

## How devices follow the Pi-hole

- A new list or group gets a device on the next poll.
- A list or group that is gone from the Pi-hole loses its device only after it was missing for 3 polls in a row, so one odd answer can not delete a device and its history.
- A device is renamed when its name changes *in the Pi-hole* while the plugin runs. A name you choose in Domoticz is never overwritten when the plugin starts.
- Do not edit the **Description** of a list or group device: it is the link to the Pi-hole.
- A device you delete in Domoticz is created again on the next poll (a list or group device: while it exists in the Pi-hole).
- Every device is created *in use* (visible), so nothing has to be added by hand under Setup > Devices. A counter that was created without a unit gets its unit at start; a unit or a hidden state you set yourself is never changed.
- Domoticz refuses new devices while *Setup > Settings > System > Accept new Hardware Devices* is off. The plugin says so once in the log and asks again every 5 minutes (statistics, lists and groups alike), so the devices appear as soon as the setting is on, without restarting the hardware.
